family_context_summary: Born in Moscow to a Russian family. His father was an engineering technician who had played chess competitively and studied under Mikhail Chigorin, becoming Smyslov's first chess teacher.

family_context_summary: Born in a public housing block in Modena to a baker/amateur tenor father and a cigar factory worker mother. The family had little money and lived in a two-room apartment.

evidence_summary: Pavarotti grew up poor in Modena with a father who was an amateur tenor and exposed him to opera records. After seven years of training while working as a teacher and insurance salesman, he won the Achille Peri Competition and made his opera debut at 25 in April 1961.
